quickSummary: Dicot stems (Helianthus) feature a collenchymatous hypodermis, starch sheath endodermis, hard bast pericycle, and a ring of open collateral vascular bundles (Eustele) with secondary growth. Monocot stems (Zea mays) feature a sclerenchymatous hypodermis, undifferentiated ground tissue, scattered closed collateral bundles (Atactostele), Y-shaped xylem with a lysigenous cavity, no phloem parenchyma, and no secondary growth.

summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: Dicot stem = Collenchyma hypodermis + Eustele ring (Open bundles). Monocot stem = Sclerenchyma hypodermis + Atactostele (Closed scattered bundles + Lysigenous cavity).

conceptBreakdown.heading: 5.1 Comparative Stem Anatomy Matrix
conceptBreakdown.title: 5.1 Comparative Stem Anatomy Matrix
conceptBreakdown.content:
| Anatomical Parameter | Dicot Stem (e.g., *Helianthus*) | Monocot Stem (e.g., *Zea mays*) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Epidermis** | Single-layered with cuticle; bears multicellular trichomes and stomata | Single-layered with thick cuticle; trichomes **ABSENT** |
| **Hypodermis** | **Collenchymatous** ($3\text{--}5$ layers); provides flexible mechanical support | **Sclerenchymatous** ($2\text{--}3$ layers); provides rigid mechanical protection |
| **Ground Tissue Differentiation** | Differentiated into General Cortex, Endodermis, Pericycle, Pith, and Rays | **UNDIFFERENTIATED**; continuous mass of parenchymatous ground tissue |
| **Endodermis / Starch Sheath** | Distinct single layer containing abundant starch grains (**Starch Sheath**) | **ABSENT** |
| **Pericycle** | Heterogeneous; sclerenchymatous **semilunar patches** above phloem (**Hard Bast**) | **ABSENT** |
| **Vascular Bundle Arrangement** | Arranged in a **regular ring** (**Eustele**) | **Scattered** throughout ground tissue (**Atactostele**) |
| **Vascular Bundle Type** | **Conjoint, Collateral, OPEN** (Cambium present) | **Conjoint, Collateral, CLOSED** (Cambium absent) |
| **Bundle Sheath** | Sclerenchymatous bundle cap present outside phloem | Each bundle completely encased by a **Sclerenchymatous Bundle Sheath** |
| **Vascular Bundle Size** | Uniform size throughout ring | Peripheral bundles are **smaller and crowded**; central bundles are **larger and spaced** |
| **Xylem Vessel Orientation** | Linear rows; protoxylem lies endarch toward pith | Arranged in a **Y or V-shape** |
| **Protoxylem Cavity** | Absent | **Lysigenous Cavity** present (formed by breakdown of inner protoxylem elements) |
| **Phloem Parenchyma** | **PRESENT** | **ABSENT** |
| **Secondary Growth** | **PRESENT** (normal secondary growth via cambial ring) | **ABSENT** (except anomalous growth in *Dracaena*, *Yucca*) |
